source_title: Noah Kahan Will Be Playing Even Bigger Stadiums Next Year
source_excerpt:
Following fans’ feverish anticipation for more shows, Noah Kahan has revealed a massive stadium run for 2027: The Last of the Bugs World Tour.
The 31-date trek kicks off on April 24 — the anniversary of his No. 1 album The Great Divide — in Athens, Georgia. The trek includes four more dates at Boston’s Fenway Park in late May, and includes a stop at New Jersey’s MetLife Stadium on June 18 (a makeup date for fans, after one of his two Citi Field shows last summer was cancelled due to inclement weather). Kahan will continue the tour in Europe, and wrap with three consecutive nights at London’s Wembley Stadium in late July.
The news arrives after a cryptic graphic teasing the tour was posted on Instagram, featuring imagery from The Great Divide . The record coincided with Kahan appearing on the cover of Rolling Stone ; Grammy nominations are likely to follow.
Earlier this month, Kahan released “ Draw You Out ,” off The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping soundtrack. In September, just before he brought The Great Divide Tour to Australia, he played his second annual “ Folk and Fairways ” charity event in his home state of Vermont. The two-day event raised over $3 million in support of mental health resources, through Kahan’s benefit organization the Busyhead Project.
General tickets for The Last of the Bugs World Tour go on sale Thursday, Nov. 12th at noon local time.
